\begin{example} \end{example}[Euclidean Spaces]

1. ch1:1.22The standard smooth structure on $\mathbb R^n$ is determined by $(\mathbb R^n,\operatorname {Id}_{\mathbb R^n})$. Its smooth charts are exactly the pairs $(U,\varphi )$ for which $\varphi $ is a Euclidean diffeomorphism from $U$ onto an open subset of $\mathbb R^n$. This is the structure used unless another is specified. \end{example}
